description: This file defines the VoiceWakeChime enum and associated logic for managing and playing sound chimes in the Voice Wake feature of an iOS/macOS app. It includes definitions for different chime types, a catalog for sound options, and a player that handles playing sounds with logging.

methods.name: systemName
methods.description: Returns the system name if the chime is of system type, otherwise nil.

methods.name: displayLabel
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly label for the chime.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Provides available system options for chimes.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns a display name for a given raw system name.

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Returns a URL for the sound resource associated with a given name.

methods.name: play(_:reason:)
methods.description: Plays a specified chime with optional reason logging.

methods.name: sound(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the NSSound object associated with a given chime.
